positions.name: ZypherionAdoptionRatifiedAsSettled
positions.frame: Is this expression a performed ratification of a settled course of action that others are expected to act on, or is it evidence offered in support of one?
positions.why: src-1 ('We are adopting Zypherion') and src-3 ('The migration starts next quarter') are both performed acts — declarative and commissive respectively — that enact the decision rather than argue for it: the relational and power reads mark both as authority-ranking/legitimate exercises of positional authority, delivered in the same calm-positive register, with src-3 operationalizing src-1's declaration into a concrete timeline. src-2's performance-multiplier claim is evidentiary support for the decision (conviction reads it as 'claim', not 'decision', and its register/affect run hotter — technical, activated-positive — a different move than the flat, settled ratifications), so it is left out of this group rather than folded in on a loose thematic tie.
